name: cs329z-chinese
tagline: Chinese tutorial for Stanford CS329Z Engineering AI Agents
description: CS329Z Chinese tutorial is a self‑study guide for Python developers that covers the Stanford Engineering AI Agents course. It provides 19 lessons, four hands‑on projects, and accompanying source code. The material can be read online, downloaded as an offline HTML site, or accessed through a browser. An AI reading companion called "阅间" lets registered users ask up to 50 questions per day about the content. The guide is aimed at readers who know basic Python and API usage and want a systematic introduction to building, evaluating, and improving AI agents in Chinese.
best_for: Self‑learners needing Chinese resources on agent systems
Developers wanting an offline HTML version of the tutorial
Users who want an AI reading companion to ask questions

free_tier.notes: Free after registration, 50 questions per day
